**What did you do?**

Enable query log and run the query `oo > 0`

**What did you expect to see?**

In the query log:

`"query":"oo > 0"`

**What did you see instead? Under which circumstances?**

In the query log:

`"query":"oo \u003e 0"`

* Prometheus version:

	v2.16.0

Additional info:

This is fix by unrelased go-kit:

https://github.com/go-kit/kit/commit/913ff7dc1f45175b3f5b094721716b3efde5b3da
https://github.com/go-kit/kit/pull/914
